text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, while NoSQL databases store data in flexible formats like documents. To get information, we write queries. Data modeling helps us plan the structure before we add data, which saves time later. Indexes make searches much faster, like an index in a book. Choosing the right database depends on your needs. SQL works well for clear relationships, while NoSQL is better for changing or large amounts of data.
